findings.text: _rank_p90 re-implements the nearest-rank percentile that imas_ambix/agent/lane_utilisation.py:489 percentile_or_none owns; that function's docstring states it is the one nearest-rank estimator for the lane's figures and that the simulation's _quantile defers to it, and lane_sim.py:165 documents the rule against a second copy. The values agree today, so no figure moves, but a change to the owner's convention would silently diverge the evidence. Passing the waits to percentile_or_none is the fix.

the module docstring's usage line states 'check <fragment> <log>' while main() binds the positionals as '<log> <fragment>' (lines 232-235); the docstring order was reproduced and exits 1 with 'the fragment states 0 seed rows', a misleading refusal. The docstring should state '<log> <fragment>' to match the verified invocation in check-green.log.
